alerts.title: NYU Shuttle Service Resumes September 2
alerts.body:
We’re pleased to announce that NYU shuttle service for all colleges will resume on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, in conjunction with the start of the Fall semester.
Students, faculty, and staff can once again use the shuttle service to travel conveniently between NYU campuses and designated stops.

Please check the current shuttle routes and schedules before traveling.

Welcome back, and we look forward to providing safe and convenient transportation throughout the semester!

alerts.title: NYU Langone Health Ferry 9/2
alerts.body:
Wednesday 9/2/26 The NYU Langone ferry is operating on the Gene Flatow Ferry.

Due to mechanical issues, there will be a boat swap at BAT for 4:30pm to the Marian Heiskell.

The GPS is currently tracking, and the ferry is running on time.
